entries.brief: ONE square original painterly fantasy bestiary illustration for SKAZ, restrained encyclopedia, broad sculpted brush shapes readable at 40 px, warm upper-left light, moderate detail. MIMIC in treasure chest form: compact weathered oak chest with simple iron bands, lid lifted as a living jaw; rows of irregular ivory teeth line both upper lid and lower rim, a single thick purple tongue curls outward into a short sticky pseudopod. No eyes required, chest silhouette dominant and unmistakable, three-quarter view, dark mouth interior. Object transformed into a predatory creature, not a normal chest with a monster inside. Entire chest and short tongue fit central 75 percent with transparent margins, no cropped edges. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No ground, coins, scenery, text, letters, border, gore or glow.

ONE square original painterly fantasy bestiary illustration for SKAZ, restrained encyclopedia, broad sculpted brush shapes readable at 40 px, warm upper-left light, moderate detail. RUST MONSTER: a compact squat four-legged chitinous creature with rust-orange segmented armored back, low insectlike head with two long soft feathery antennae extending forward, small dark eyes and mandibled mouth, long thick tail curling to the side ending in a broad fan-shaped paddle. Three-quarter whole-creature view, all FOUR sturdy short legs anatomically coherent, both antennae and fan tail wholly visible within generous margins. One antenna touches a small old iron horseshoe that crumbles into a few rusty flakes, no lightning or magic beam. The creature is the dominant silhouette, horseshoe tiny. Earthy orange-brown shell, cool shadow, no wings. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No ground, scenery, text, letters, frame or gore.
